input_text: Dave is being sued by Taylor Swift for copyright infringement. To prove that Dave had listened to Taylor Swift, the plaintiffs introduced evidence of Dave telling his friend that his favorite artist was Taylor Swift.

extraction.input_text: Dave is being sued by Taylor Swift for copyright infringement. To prove that Dave had listened to Taylor Swift, the plaintiffs introduced evidence of Dave telling his friend that his favorite artist was Taylor Swift.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The statement was made out of court, as Dave communicated it to his friend outside of the trial proceedings.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(1) - A statement is hearsay if it is made on a basis other than while testifying at the current trial or hearing.

arguments.text: The statement contains an assertion, specifically Dave's claim that his favorite artist was Taylor Swift.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(a) - 'Statement' includes a person's oral assertion, written assertion, or nonverbal conduct if intended as an assertion.
arguments.evidence_span: that his favorite artist was Taylor Swift

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, as the plaintiffs introduced it specifically to establish that Dave had listened to Taylor Swift.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(3) - A statement is hearsay if it is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted in the statement.
arguments.evidence_span: To prove that Dave had listened to Taylor Swift
